title: Litter Box Usage Health Signal
dataSources: Pet tracker location/activity (`tractive:position`, `whistle:activity`), smart feeder events (`petfeeder:event`), litter-box usage (`litterrobot:cycle`), bird-feeder detections.
app: Pet GPS/activity trackers (Tractive/Fi/Whistle), smart feeders and litter boxes, bird feeders/cams, and plant sensors via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=litterrobot:cycle
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as visits by _time
| eventstats avg(visits) as avg_visits, stdev(visits) as sd_visits
| eval anomaly=if(abs(visits-avg_visits)>2*sd_visits,1,0)
| where anomaly=1
description: Trends how often the litter box is used and flags sudden changes, which for cats can be an early sign of a urinary or kidney problem.
value: Cats hide illness well, but litter-box frequency does not; an anomaly alert can prompt a vet visit before a problem becomes serious.
implementation: Forward litter-box cycle events; schedule daily and alert on a significant change in usage frequency.
visualization: Chart of daily litter-box visits with anomaly markers.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how often the cat uses the litter box, because a sudden change can be an early sign of illness.
